svg.title: TransSync AI – Frontend Architecture & Integration Flow
svg.desc: Full architectural flow from user-facing React pages through the FastAPI backend to the AI pipeline and Supabase, with state management and data contracts annotated at each layer boundary.
svg.text: React frontend · Vite + React 19 + TailwindCSS v4 · react-router-dom v7
